shortDescription: The FTSE 100 Index dropped 44 points or 0.41 percent on Tuesday to close at 10654 points.Losses were led by Relx (-2.59%), Glencore (-2.52%) and Antofagasta (-2.37%).Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Babcock International (3.45%), BAE Systems (2.77%) and Kingfisher (2.05%).

children: The FTSE 100 Index dropped 44 points or 0.41 percent on Tuesday to close at 10654 points.
Losses were led by Relx (-2.59%), Glencore (-2.52%) and Antofagasta (-2.37%).
Offsetting the fall, top gainers were Babcock International (3.45%), BAE Systems (2.77%) and Kingfisher (2.05%).

title: The FTSE 100 Index Closes 0.41% Lower
